# 1\. Executive Summary

This document defines Module 08 - User & Access Management for the AMR Coordinator Portal (iPOMS). It consolidates the complete business discussion - initial recommendations, business corrections, and final decisions - into a single functional specification.

This module is the Identity & Access Control Center of iPOMS. It governs every user who can access the system: registration, login, profiles, roles and permissions, college assignment, account status, password management, and user security.

# 2\. Purpose

Module 08 controls:

- User Registration
- User Login
- User Profiles
- Roles & Permissions
- College Assignment
- Account Status
- Password Management
- User Security

# 3\. Who Can Access This Module

Initial recommendation: only the Administrator should create, edit, deactivate, and manage users.

Business correction: Team Leaders sometimes perform administrative work on behalf of the CEO or Director, so Team Leaders also require user management access.

| **Role**              | **User Management Access** |
| --------------------- | -------------------------- |
| Placement Coordinator | No                         |
| Team Leader           | Yes                        |
| Director              | Yes                        |
| CEO                   | Yes                        |

# 4\. User Management Features

Team Leaders, Director, and CEO can:

- Create User
- Edit User
- Activate User
- Deactivate User
- Block User
- Reset Password
- Assign Colleges
- Transfer Colleges
- View User Profile

Placement Coordinators cannot manage other users.

# 5\. User Status

The status list started as Active, Inactive, and On Leave. A practical addition - Partial Working - was introduced to represent an employee working only part of the day (for example, morning only, afternoon only, a medical appointment, or half-day leave).

Final status list:

- Active
- Partial Working
- On Leave
- Inactive
- Blocked
- Deactivated

# 6\. Blocked vs Deactivated

This distinction was added later in the discussion, since the two are easy to confuse.

| **Status**  | **Meaning**                                                                                                                                                  |
| ----------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| Blocked     | Temporary. Cannot log in; everything inside the account is disabled. Can be unblocked at any time. Used for investigation, temporary restriction, or misuse. |
| Deactivated | The employee has left the company. Cannot log in. Historical data and reports remain accurate. Preferred over deleting the account.                          |

# 7\. Password Management

Initial proposal: Reset Password, Change Password, Force Password Change, and a Temporary Password issued by the organization.

Business correction: there are no temporary passwords. Every user manages their own password; the organization never sets a password on a user's behalf.

Final decision: every user can change their own password. Team Leaders, Director, and CEO can additionally reset a user's password as an account-recovery action.

- Change Password - user-initiated, can be done at any time: Current Password → New Password → Confirm Password → Save.
- Reset Password - account recovery for a forgotten password or a returning employee; the process starts again and the user creates their own new password after verification. There is no administrator-generated password.

# 8\. Password Policy

A password must contain:

- Minimum 8 characters
- One uppercase letter
- One lowercase letter
- One number
- One special character

Example: Info@2026

# 9\. User Profile Card

Table-only management was replaced with a profile card: clicking a user opens a full profile page rather than an inline table edit.

Profile fields:

- Name
- Role
- Status
- Official Email
- Personal Email
- Official Mobile
- Assigned Colleges
- Last Login
- Created Date

Quick actions available from the profile:

- Edit User
- Assign Colleges
- Reset Password
- Change Status
- Deactivate User

# 10\. College Assignment - Workload Rule

Business rule: a coordinator normally manages 3 colleges, rarely 4, and never an unlimited number in practice.

| **Workload**      | **Colleges** |
| ----------------- | ------------ |
| Recommended       | 3 Colleges   |
| Maximum practical | 4 Colleges   |

# 12\. Signup Process

Initial proposal: anyone signs up, requests a role, and an Administrator approves the request.

Business correction: approval is not required - it is unnecessary overhead. Only Placement Coordinators can register; Team Leaders, Director, and CEO already have their accounts.

Signup form fields:

- Full Name
- Username
- Official Email
- Personal Email
- Official Mobile
- Date of Birth
- Password
- Confirm Password

# 13\. OTP Verification

Initial proposal: Email OTP, SMS OTP, and WhatsApp OTP.

Final decision for Version 1: Official Email OTP only. SMS and WhatsApp OTP are deferred to a future version and can both be added later.

# 14\. Login Process

Coordinator login: Signup → Email Verification → Account Created → Login.

Team Leader, Director, and CEO login: Username → Password → Login - there is no signup page for these roles.

# 15\. Forgot Password

Final flow: Forgot Password → Enter Username → Email Verification → Create New Password → Login. No administrator involvement is required.

# 16\. Login & Signup Design Decisions

Username vs Email vs Employee ID: Version 1 uses Username as the primary login identifier. A future option allows the Administrator to switch login to Email if needed.

Role selection at signup: initially, users would select their own role (Coordinator, Team Leader, Director, CEO) during signup. This was corrected for security - users should never see those options. The signup page now shows only Placement Coordinator; leadership accounts are created separately, outside the signup flow.

# 17\. College Assignment After Signup & Dashboard Integration

College assignment was not part of the original signup discussion. Recommendation: a coordinator should not choose their own colleges, since college assignment is an organizational decision.

Final flow: Signup creates the account → a Team Leader assigns colleges → the Coordinator Dashboard updates automatically.

This module connects directly with Module 07 (Role-Based Dashboard): once colleges are assigned, the dashboard automatically shows Assigned Colleges, Today's Tasks, Assigned Work, Reports, KPIs, and Follow-ups, with no manual filtering.

# 18\. Security Rules

- Passwords are never stored as plain text.
- Users only access permitted data.
- Coordinators cannot view other coordinators.
- Team Leaders can view all coordinator data.
- Director and CEO can access everything.
- Blocked users cannot log in.
- Deactivated users remain in history but cannot access the system.

# 19\. Business Rules Summary

- Team Leaders manage users because they often act on behalf of the CEO or Director.
- The Partial Working status represents half-day or limited daily availability.
- Change Password is user-initiated and always available; Reset Password is an account-recovery action available to Team Leaders, Director, and CEO.
- No administrator-generated or temporary passwords are used anywhere in the system.
- Only Placement Coordinators can self-register; Team Leader, Director, and CEO accounts are created separately.
- Username is the primary login identifier for Version 1, with Email as a possible future option.
- A coordinator's real workload is 3 colleges normally, 4 in exceptional cases.
- Coordinators never select their own colleges; assignments come from a Team Leader or Administrator.
- Blocked accounts are temporary and reversible; Deactivated accounts are permanent and preserve historical data instead of deleting it.

# 20\. Deferred / Out of Scope for v1.0

- Temporary or administrator-generated passwords.
- An administrator approval step after signup.
- SMS and WhatsApp OTP verification (Email OTP only in v1.0).
- Role selection during signup.
- Employee ID or Email as the primary login identifier (Username only in v1.0; Email switchable later by an Administrator).
- Unlimited or self-selected college assignment.

# 21\. Conclusion

Module 08 is considered functionally complete for Version 1.0. User & Access Management is now aligned with the organization's real-world workflow - Team Leader administrative access, a Coordinator-only signup flow, user-managed passwords, and a practical college workload limit - rather than a generic identity system, which will make implementation simpler and daily operations more natural.

# 22\. Next Module

Module 09 - Notifications: expected to define how CEO, Director, Team Leader, and System-generated messages are created, targeted, and delivered - building on the roles and permissions established in this module.
